course.title: Coordinate Geometry and Differential Equations
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Test whether the four points (0, 1, 2), (3, 0, 1), (4, 3, 6) and (2, 3, 2) coplanar or not, and (12) [CO4] calculate the followings:
i) If coplanar, then find the equation of plane containing them, or
ii) If non-coplanar, then find the volume of a tetrahedron whose vertices are these four points.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
